name: Greg Colt
tagline: Life Path & Career Guide · Life coaching
bio:
I’m Greg - a Certified Life Coach with 16+ years of experience helping people navigate life’s challenges with clarity and purpose. Whether it’s family, career, or finances, I support you in aligning with what truly matters. Raised on a remote island, I learned resilience early on—how to face trials with patience, persistence, and trust that every hardship carries hidden wisdom.

Today, I bring that same discipline to my coaching, offering guidance that is practical, principled, and accessible worldwide. I don’t deal in predictions or so-called secrets of the unseen. I don’t claim to tell the future—I help you understand the present, so you can make better choices for the future that is yet to unfold.

My role is not to foresee, but to help you see more clearly. I won’t sugarcoat reality. Instead, I’ll help you see situations for what they are, make balanced choices, and take structured steps forward—with the assurance that growth comes in its appointed time, and that no effort is ever wasted.

Together, we’ll identify what you NEED so you can move toward what you truly WANT. You don’t have to remain in unhealthy relationships, unfulfilling work, or poor financial habits—there is always a way forward for those willing to walk with sincerity and trust in the process.
